name: net_reconnect_from_checkpoint
description: Two seats played by the plan bots. At wave 5 client 2's link is cut and the server cannot be reached for 20 s: it keeps its world (reconnecting, orders refused), retries every 2 s, and its seat goes AWAY, the caretaker building for it. Then its resume HELLO (same token, match 1, wire seat 1) takes the seat back: MATCH_CONFIG(rejoin) and RESYNC(rejoin) from the latest agreed checkpoint, the parts and the turns since paced as the catch-up; it loads the checkpoint, catches up with a moving bar, says shown, and BACK hands the seat back at the next build window, where its own orders go out again. Every hash it sends after the rejoin agrees.

steps.assert: at_wave5 and scene.client(2).phase_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and not scene.client(1).sim.over
steps.msg: the bots held the hollow to wave 5
the sequencer keeps the last two agreed checkpoints

steps.assert: scene.client(2).reconnecting and scene.client(2).phase_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and scene.client(2).held_match == 1 and scene.client(2).held_seat == 1
steps.msg: the lost link keeps the world: reconnecting, holding match 1's wire seat 1

steps.assert: not scene.client(2).source.accepts_commands() and scene.client(2).source.refusal() == 'Reconnecting to the server'

steps.msg: it tried every 2 s while the server could not be reached
the next resume HELLO got the seat back: RESYNC(rejoin)
from a checkpoint the sequencer kept
a checkpoint at most 1,800 ticks before the cut
the overlay said reconnecting, then catching up, then welcome back while the caretaker holds the seat
the catch-up's bar moved to its end
client 2 runs level with client 1 again

steps.assert: back and scene.system_sent('BACK', 1) and scene.client(1).sim.seat(2).state == 2 and scene.client(2).sim.seat(2).state == 2
steps.msg: shown brought it BACK: returning until the next window
the seat was handed back as a build window opened
handed back in its own simulation too, the plate went
its own orders were never refused as the caretaker's
every hash both sent from the checkpoint on agrees
